principles: Missing analytics remain UNKNOWN and produce no calibration candidate.
Engagement can indicate attention but cannot establish willingness to pay.
Add-to-cart can strengthen buyer-intent evidence but is not payment.
Observed orders without revenue are sale-proxy evidence, not known spend magnitude.
Observed orders plus observed revenue can create REVEALED_SPEND evidence and recommend STRONG WTP.
A zero observed order value does not automatically downgrade demand because channel, creative, exposure quality and sample size are confounders.
Observed channel/product outcomes are associations; causal_claim is always false in this layer.
Calibration output is a CANDIDATE only; canonical demand mutation is never authorized by ANL-002.
